system.description: When you use the Aid Another Action to grant a bonus on attack rolls, if you are aiding the target of your Dedicated Protector Talent, that ally also gains a +2 bonus to damage rolls on the attack you aided.

prerequisite.text: Dedicated Protector talent, and Harm's Way talent
